func (r *MasterBindingRepo) ListMasterTargetsByShadowTable(ctx context.Context, shadowTable string) ([]MasterTargetIdentity, error) {
	var result []MasterTargetIdentity
	err := r.db.WithContext(ctx).Raw(
		`SELECT DISTINCT mb.id,
		        COALESCE(NULLIF(mb.master_schema, ''), 'public') || '.' || mb.master_table AS master_fqn,
		        COALESCE(cr.connection_code, '') AS master_connection_key
		   FROM cdc_system.master_binding mb
		   JOIN cdc_system.shadow_binding sb ON (
		     sb.id = mb.shadow_binding_id
		     OR EXISTS (
		       SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(
		         CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(mb.transform_spec->'shadow_sources') = 'array' THEN mb.transform_spec->'shadow_sources' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
		       ) elem
		        WHERE (CASE WHEN (elem->>'shadow_binding_id') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (elem->>'shadow_binding_id')::bigint END) = sb.id
		           OR elem->>'shadow_table' = sb.shadow_table
		     )
		   )
		   LEFT JOIN cdc_system.connection_registry cr ON cr.id = mb.master_connection_id
		  WHERE sb.shadow_table = ? AND mb.is_active = true AND mb.schema_status = 'approved'`,
		shadowTable,
	).Scan(&result).Error
	return result, err
}

		        COALESCE(mcr.connection_code, '') AS master_connection_key
		   FROM cdc_system.master_binding mb
		   JOIN cdc_system.shadow_binding sb ON (
		     sb.id = mb.shadow_binding_id
		     OR EXISTS (
		       SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(
		         CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(mb.transform_spec->'shadow_sources') = 'array' THEN mb.transform_spec->'shadow_sources' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
		       ) elem
		        WHERE (CASE WHEN (elem->>'shadow_binding_id') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (elem->>'shadow_binding_id')::bigint END) = sb.id
		           OR (elem->>'shadow_table' = sb.shadow_table
		               AND COALESCE(NULLIF(elem->>'shadow_schema', ''), sb.shadow_schema) = sb.shadow_schema)

		   )
